## C2 — Confusable pairs and knowledge-graph hints: change deadlines, designations, records and the road test
Look-alike rules from the records, change-reporting and road-test pages, each tied to one handbook page; hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
Name changes and address changes share one deadline in Arizona: both must reach MVD within 10 days, so there is no separate longer window for a name change. [A01]
Why it matters: group change deadlines; difficulty one; confusable sec01-F09 versus sec01-F14.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
An address change can be done entirely online, while the manual sends a name change to an MVD or authorized third party office with identification in both names. [A01]
Why it matters: group change deadlines; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F11 versus sec01-F14.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
Filing an address change updates MVD records but leaves the old address on your card until you buy a replacement license. [A01]
Why it matters: group change deadlines; difficulty two; prereq sec01-F12.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
A revoked, suspended or canceled license can cost two charges, a new application fee plus a reinstatement fee, not just one reinstatement fee. [A01]
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty two; prereq sec01-F01.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A01
An out-of-state license brought to MVD works as secondary identification and may waive the written or road test, and you still bring the required identification as well. [A01]
Why it matters: group documents; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F06 versus sec01-F07.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
The 90-day allowance for discharged service members is a work allowance that applies only when all three conditions hold, not a general grace period for every new arrival. [A02]
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty three; confusable sec01-F17 versus sec01-F18.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
Service members stationed in Arizona under the relief act exemption are not residents, which is different from the post-discharge rule that limits work on an outside license. [A02]
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F16 versus sec01-F17.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
The VETERAN mark is open to veterans and active duty members, while the NATIVE AMERICAN mark requires enrollment in a federally recognized tribe located in Arizona. [A02]
Why it matters: group designations; difficulty one; confusable sec01-F19 versus sec01-F20.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A03
Legal presence is a gate for both issuing and renewing a license or ID card, not only for a first license. [A03]
Why it matters: group eligibility; difficulty two; prereq sec01-F23.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A03
Sign knowledge and the spoken English directions are checked before the road test starts, whereas the route and grading happen during the drive. [A03]
Why it matters: group road test; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F28 versus sec01-F26.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A03
A road test vehicle needs both an inside and an outside rearview mirror and a windshield with no cracks; one mirror or a small crack does not meet the list. [A03]
Why it matters: group road test; difficulty two; prereq sec01-F30.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A03
Road tests can be suspended for extreme weather or safety conditions even when an appointment was booked, so a booking is not a guarantee. [A03]
Why it matters: group road test; difficulty one; confusable sec01-F27 versus sec01-F25.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0008]
